sheet.title: Stock Register
sheet.intro: Keep track of what comes in and what goes out. The Stock sheet works out what is left for every item and flags the ones to order, and the Order List gives you a ready shopping list. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name. Open Items and list what you keep: the name, the unit, the stock you have now (Opening stock), the level at which you want to reorder, and the cost and sale price.
Open Stock Log. Each time stock comes in or goes out, add a row: the date, the item, In or Out, and the quantity. Pick the item from the list so the name always matches.
The Stock sheet shows what is left for every item and a status: OK, Order now or Out of stock. Use the filter on the Status heading to see only what needs ordering.
Order List shows every item that needs ordering, with a suggested quantity and an estimated cost. Summary shows the value of your stock and charts.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam likhein. Items mein jo maal rakhte hain uski list likhein: naam, unit, abhi ka stock (Opening stock), kis level par dobara mangwana hai, aur cost aur sale price.
Stock Log kholein. Jab bhi maal aaye ya jaye, ek row jodein: tareekh, item, In ya Out, aur quantity. Item list se chunein taaki naam hamesha sahi rahe.
Stock sheet mein har item ka bacha hua maal aur status dikhta hai: OK, Order now ya Out of stock. Status heading ke filter se sirf wo items dekhein jo mangwane hain.
Order List mein wo saare items hain jo mangwane hain, saath mein sujhai gayi quantity aur andaza kharch. Summary mein stock ki keemat aur chart hain.

sheet.title: Credit Ledger (Udhaar Khata)
sheet.intro: Keep track of who owes you money. Add a row each time you give credit or receive a payment. The Balances sheet works out what each customer owes, how old it is, who is over their limit, and gives you a WhatsApp reminder link. Print a statement for any customer. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name, the credit period in days and your reminder message. Open Customers and list each customer with a phone number, what they owe at the start (Opening balance) and, if you like, a credit limit.

Open Entries. Each time you give credit or receive a payment, add a row: the date, the customer, Credit given or Payment received, and the amount. Pick the customer from the list so the name always matches.

The Balances sheet shows what each customer owes, split by how old it is, and a status: Current, Overdue or Clear. Payments are counted against the oldest credit first. Tap Send reminder to open WhatsApp with the message ready.
Statement prints one customer's entries with a running balance. Summary shows the total outstanding, what is overdue and charts.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam, credit period (din mein) aur reminder message likhein. Customers mein har customer ka phone, shuru mein kitna baaki hai (Opening balance) aur chahein to credit limit likhein.
Entries kholein. Jab bhi udhaar do ya paisa aaye, ek row jodein: tareekh, customer, Credit given ya Payment received, aur rakam. Customer list se chunein taaki naam hamesha sahi rahe.

Balances sheet mein har customer ka baaki, kitna purana hai us hisaab se, aur status dikhta hai: Current, Overdue ya Clear. Payment sabse purane udhaar se kat'ti hai. Send reminder dabane par WhatsApp message ke saath khulta hai.
Statement mein ek customer ki entries running balance ke saath print hoti hain. Summary mein kul baaki, overdue aur chart hain.

sheet.title: Timesheet with Overtime
sheet.intro: Log start and end times, and get hours worked, overtime over the daily limit you set, and totals and pay for any period. Hours above the normal hours in a day count as overtime. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name, the period you want totals for, the normal hours per day and the overtime multiplier. Open People and list each person with an hourly rate if you want pay worked out.

Open Time Log. For each shift add a row: the date, the person, the start and end time (like 9:00 and 17:30) and the break in minutes. Hours, regular hours and overtime are worked out. Use one row per person per day.
Open Totals. For the period in Settings it shows each person's days worked, regular and overtime hours, and pay. Change the dates in Settings to see another period.
Hours above the normal hours in a day are orange in the log. Pay is only what your hourly rate and multiplier give: check it against your own rules before paying anyone.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam, jis period ka total chahiye wo, roz ke normal ghante aur overtime multiplier likhein. People mein har vyakti ka hourly rate likhein agar pay nikalni hai.

Time Log kholein. Har shift ke liye ek row jodein: tareekh, vyakti, shuru aur khatam ka samay (jaise 9:00 aur 17:30) aur break minute mein. Ghante, regular aur overtime apne aap nikalte hain. Ek vyakti ka ek din ek row.
Totals kholein. Settings ke period ke liye har vyakti ke din, regular aur overtime ghante aur pay dikhta hai. Dusra period dekhne ke liye Settings mein tareekh badlein.
Din ke normal ghante se zyada ghante log mein orange dikhte hain. Pay sirf aapke rate aur multiplier se nikalti hai: bhugtan se pehle apne niyam se jaanch lein.

sheet.title: Monthly Fees and Rent Tracker
sheet.intro: For school or tuition fees, rent, society maintenance or gym memberships. Type what each person paid each month. The tracker works out what is due so far, what is still pending, who has not paid, and gives you a WhatsApp reminder link and a printable receipt. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your name, what you collect, the first month and your reminder message. Open People and list each person with a phone number, a class or flat, the monthly amount and, if something was already due, the opening balance.
Open Tracker. Type the amount each person paid in the month column. A month turns green when paid in full, amber when part paid and red when it is due and not paid. Months still to come are grey.
Pending lists everyone who still owes money, with the balance and a Send reminder link that opens WhatsApp with the message ready.
Receipt makes a printable receipt: pick the person and the month. Summary shows what you expected, what you collected and what is outstanding, with a chart.
guideHi: Settings mein apna naam, kya collect karte hain, pehla mahina aur reminder message likhein. People mein har vyakti ka phone, class ya flat, mahine ki rakam aur agar pehle se kuch baaki ho to opening balance likhein.
Tracker kholein. Har mahine ke column mein likhein kisne kitna diya. Poora diya to mahina green, aadha diya to amber aur dena tha par nahi diya to red hota hai. Aane wale mahine grey hain.
Pending mein un sabki list hai jinse paisa baaki hai, balance aur Send reminder link ke saath jo WhatsApp message ke saath kholta hai.
Receipt se print karne layak receipt banti hai: vyakti aur mahina chunein. Summary mein expected, collected aur outstanding chart ke saath dikhte hain.

sheet.title: Daily Cash Book
sheet.intro: Write down money in and money out as it happens. The Month sheet shows your profit, the balance in each payment mode (cash, bank, UPI) and where the money went, and the Year sheet shows every month. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name and the month. Open Lists and check your income types, expense types and payment modes. Type the balance you start with in each mode. You can change any list.

Open Cash Book. For each thing that happens add a row: the date, the details, the payment mode, and either money in (with its income type) or money out (with its expense type). Pick from the lists so the names always match.

Month shows money in, money out and profit for the month in Settings, the balance in each payment mode, a breakdown by category and a chart of each day. Change the month in Settings to look at another month.
Year shows money in, money out and profit for every month of that year. A red Check on a row means something is missing, such as the date or the type.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam aur mahina likhein. Lists mein apni income type, kharch type aur payment mode dekhein. Har mode mein shuru ka balance likhein. Koi bhi list badal sakte hain.

Cash Book kholein. Jo bhi hota hai uski ek row jodein: tareekh, vivaran, payment mode, aur ya to aaya hua paisa (income type ke saath) ya gaya hua paisa (kharch type ke saath). Lists se chunein taaki naam hamesha sahi rahe.

Month mein Settings ke mahine ka aaya paisa, gaya paisa aur munafa, har payment mode ka balance, category ke hisaab se breakdown aur har din ka chart dikhta hai. Dusra mahina dekhne ke liye Settings mein badlein.
Year mein us saal ke har mahine ka aaya paisa, gaya paisa aur munafa dikhta hai. Row par laal Check ka matlab kuch chhoot gaya hai, jaise tareekh ya type.

sheet.title: Monthly Budget Planner
sheet.intro: Plan what you expect to earn and spend each month, then type what really happened. The planner shows what is left over each month, how each line compares with your plan, and charts for the year. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type a name for the budget and the first month. The planner covers 12 months from then.
Open Budget. List your income lines and your spending lines, and type the planned amount per month in the Planned column. Add or rename lines as you like.

Each month, type what really came in and what you really spent in that month's column. A spending box turns amber when it is above the plan. Left over shows income minus spending, and turns red when it is below zero.
The last columns compare the real amounts so far with the plan so far. A green figure is better than plan and a red one is worse. Summary shows the totals and a chart for the year.
guideHi: Settings mein budget ka naam aur pehla mahina likhein. Planner us mahine se 12 mahine ko dekhta hai.
Budget kholein. Apni income aur kharch ki lines likhein aur Planned column mein har mahine ki yojana likhein. Lines jodein ya naam badlein.

Har mahine us mahine ke column mein likhein kitna aaya aur kitna kharch hua. Kharch yojana se zyada ho to box amber ho jata hai. Left over mein income minus kharch dikhta hai aur zero se kam ho to red hota hai.
Aakhri columns mein ab tak ka asli aur ab tak ki yojana ki tulna hai. Green yojana se behtar aur red kharab hai. Summary mein total aur saal ka chart hai.

sheet.title: Supplier Payment Tracker
sheet.intro: Never miss a supplier payment. Type each bill with its date and amount. The tracker works out the due date from the credit days you type, shows what is overdue or due soon, and adds up what you owe each supplier. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name, the default credit days and how many days before the due date you want a warning. Open Suppliers and list each supplier, with their own credit days if they differ.

Open Bills. For each bill add a row: the bill date, the supplier, the bill number and the amount. The due date is the bill date plus the credit days: from the bill if you type them, otherwise the supplier's, otherwise the default.
When you pay, type the amount paid and the date in the same row. The balance and status update: Paid, Due soon, Overdue or Not due. Use the filter on the Status heading to see only the bills to pay.
Totals shows what you owe each supplier and how much is overdue. Summary shows what is payable, overdue and due soon, with charts. Check due dates against your own agreements.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam, default credit days aur due date se kitne din pehle chetavni chahiye wo likhein. Suppliers mein har supplier likhein, agar unke credit days alag hon to wo bhi.

Bills kholein. Har bill ke liye ek row jodein: bill ki tareekh, supplier, bill number aur rakam. Due date = bill ki tareekh + credit days: bill mein likhe hon to wo, nahi to supplier ke, nahi to default.
Jab payment karein to usi row mein rakam aur tareekh likhein. Balance aur status badal jate hain: Paid, Due soon, Overdue ya Not due. Status heading ke filter se sirf wo bill dekhein jo dene hain.
Totals mein har supplier ko kitna dena hai aur kitna overdue hai dikhta hai. Summary mein payable, overdue aur due soon chart ke saath hain. Due date apne samjhaute se milakar dekhein.
